records.title: Encyclopaedia Mundarica: In 16 Volumes, Volume 13
supports: a later commercial manifestation is explicitly marketed/catalogued as a 16-volume series
the 16-volume numbering belongs to a later manifestation scheme and must not be assumed identical to the historical government-printing volume scheme
does_not_verify: one-to-one historical-volume mapping for commercial volumes XIV-XVI

manifestation_model.historical_government_printing_scheme: treat as a separate manifestation lineage from later commercial 16-volume reprints
manifestation_model.commercial_16_volume_scheme: treat volumes XIV-XVI as reprint-manifestation labels until exact content/page concordance is independently verified
manifestation_model.canonicalization_rule: never infer that a commercial volume number equals a historical government-printing volume number without a verified table of contents/page concordance
manifestation_model.completeness_rule: a complete commercial 16-volume set would not by itself prove a complete historical government-printing manifestation, and vice versa
manifestation_model.ocr_rule: provider indexing or bibliographic visibility does not count as verified OCR

release_gate_effect: reduces manifestation-numbering ambiguity but does not satisfy Mundarica acquisition/OCR/page-accounting completion gate
